task_completion.description: The agent opens the specified EEG recording file in an analysis tool or viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or application showing 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt' being selected or opened.

task_completion.description: The agent displays the EEG waveforms, specifically focusing on Channels 1 and 2 (Fp1/Fp2).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A GUI window showing multiple EEG traces, with labels like 'Fp1', 'Fp2', 'Channel 1', or 'EXG Channel 0' visible.

task_completion.description: The agent locates the first large, rounded deflection (eye blink) in the early part of the recording.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a zoom-in window positioned over a high-amplitude peak (approx. 80uV+) in the first few seconds of the Fp1/Fp2 traces.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies the specific time (in seconds) corresponding to the peak of the first blink.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent highlighting a specific point on the X-axis or a tooltip/status bar showing a time value in seconds near the first artifact.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the numerical timestamp to the specified output file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., 'echo ... > /home/ga/blink_timestamp.txt') or a text editor saving a single numerical value to that path.

integrity.description: The agent actually interacts with the EEG data rather than guessing or using hardcoded values from the prompt.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent scrolling through or zooming into the EEG waveform before determining the timestamp.

integrity.description: The agent does not simply cat/echo a value without first opening the data file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots must show the EEG file being opened *before* the output file is created.

integrity.description: The agent specifically looks at the frontal channels (Fp1/Fp2) as instructed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UI focus or cursor placement is on the top two channels of the EEG display.
